"""S10.5 go-live checklist: what a real shop needs before "Launch for real".

Drafts and practice launches are never blocked by this. Only a real launch is (routers/launch.py, at plan time and
again at approval). Each item is plain words for the owner. Owner-confirmed steps are stored with the exact value
that was confirmed, so changing the WhatsApp number or the UPI ID / name quietly undoes the confirmation.
"""

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass

from sqlmodel import Session

from app.agents.reader import Profile, indian_mobile
from app.models import Business
from app.safety.access import owner_emails


@dataclass
class Item:
    key: str
    label: str  # what is needed, in plain words
    done: bool
    hint: str = ""  # what to do next when it isn't done


def upi_key(profile: Profile) -> str:
    return f"{profile.upi_id}|{profile.upi_display_name.strip()}"


def whatsapp_confirmed(b: Business, profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.whatsapp) and b.wa_confirmed == profile.whatsapp


def upi_confirmed(b: Business, profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.upi_id and profile.upi_display_name.strip()) and b.upi_confirmed == upi_key(profile)


def checklist(session: Session, b: Business) -> list[Item]:
    p = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json)
    priced = [x for x in p.products if not x.addon and x.price_inr > 0]
    has_way = p.pickup_available or p.delivery_available
    way_ok = has_way and (not p.delivery_available or bool(p.delivery_areas.strip())) \
        and (not p.pickup_available or bool(p.area.strip()))
    return [
        Item("email", "A verified sign-in email for orders and alerts", bool(owner_emails(session, b.id)) and not b.guest_hash,
             "Sign in with your email."),
        Item("shop", "Shop name, shop address and at least one item with a price",
             bool(p.name.strip() and b.subdomain and priced), "Add an item with its price."),
        Item("whatsapp", "Your WhatsApp number, checked by you", whatsapp_confirmed(b, p) and indian_mobile(p.whatsapp) is not None,
             "Add your WhatsApp number, tap “Test this number”, then “Yes, that's me”." if p.whatsapp
             else "Add your WhatsApp number."),
        Item("upi", "Your UPI ID and the name your UPI app shows, checked by you", upi_confirmed(b, p),
             "Do the ₹1 UPI test and confirm the name matches." if p.upi_id and p.upi_display_name.strip()
             else "Add your UPI ID and the name your UPI app shows."),
        Item("fulfilment", "How customers get their order: pickup (your area) and/or delivery (areas and fee)", way_ok,
             "Choose pickup or delivery." if not has_way
             else "Add the areas you deliver to." if p.delivery_available and not p.delivery_areas.strip()
             else "Add your area or locality for pickup."),
        Item("rules", "Your working days and hours (and how many days' notice you need)", bool(p.hours.strip()),
             "Add your working days and hours."),
        Item("agreements", "You confirmed you make or sell these yourself, and accepted the Terms",
             b.own_goods_at is not None and b.terms_at is not None, "Tick both boxes and save."),
        Item("preview", "You looked at your shop's preview at least once", b.previewed_at is not None,
             "Tap “Preview my shop”."),
    ]


def missing(session: Session, b: Business) -> list[Item]:
    return [i for i in checklist(session, b) if not i.done]


def refusal(items: list[Item]) -> str:
    return "Before your shop can go live, please finish: " + "; ".join(i.label.lower() for i in items) + "."


def out(session: Session, b: Business) -> dict:
    items = checklist(session, b)
    return {"ready": all(i.done for i in items), "items": [asdict(i) for i in items]}
"""Orders placed through a seller site's form: validate, store, email."""

import json
import re
import secrets
from datetime import timedelta

from sqlmodel import Session, func, select

from app import audit
from app.agents.reader import Profile
from app.config import Settings
from app.mail.smtp import Mailer
from app.models import Business, Order, utcnow
from app.safety.access import owner_emails, run_by_team

MAX_QTY = 50

# The owner's order status. New → Confirmed → Paid → Done, or Cancelled before it's done. Paid can be
# skipped (cash on pickup). Nothing goes back, and Done / Cancelled are final.
STATUS_STEPS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "new": ("confirmed", "cancelled"),
    "confirmed": ("paid", "done", "cancelled"),
    "paid": ("done", "cancelled"),
    "done": (),
    "cancelled": (),
}
STATUS_LABELS = {"new": "New", "confirmed": "Confirmed", "paid": "Paid", "done": "Done", "cancelled": "Cancelled"}


def can_move(current: str, to: str) -> bool:
    return to in STATUS_STEPS.get(current, ())


def customer_whatsapp_link(shop_name: str, order: Order) -> str | None:
    """A wa.me link to the CUSTOMER's phone with a ready-typed message from the owner. Nothing is sent by us:
    the owner's own WhatsApp opens with the text, and she presses send."""
    from urllib.parse import quote

    from app.sites.render import format_inr, whatsapp_digits

    number = whatsapp_digits(order.customer_phone)
    if not 11 <= len(number) <= 15:  # 10-digit Indian mobiles were given +91 above
        return None
    first = order.customer_name.split()[0] if order.customer_name.split() else ""
    text = (f"Hi {first}, this is {shop_name}. Got your order {order.ref} for {format_inr(order.total_inr)}. "
            "I'll confirm the details here.")
    return f"https://wa.me/{number}?text={quote(text, safe='')}"


def tel_link(phone: str) -> str:
    from app.sites.render import whatsapp_digits

    digits = whatsapp_digits(phone)
    return f"tel:+{digits}" if digits else ""


class OrderInvalid(ValueError):
    """Message is shown to the customer as-is."""


def parse_order_form(form: dict[str, str], profile: Profile) -> dict:
    if form.get("website"):  # honeypot field, hidden from people
        raise OrderInvalid("Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.")
    name = " ".join(form.get("customer_name", "").split())[:80]
    phone = form.get("customer_phone", "").strip()
    note = form.get("note", "").strip()[:1000]
    if profile.allow_item_message:
        message = " ".join(form.get("item_message", "").split())[:200]
        if message:
            note = f"Message on the item: {message}" + (f"\n{note}" if note else "")
    if not name:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please add your name so we know who the order is for.")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\+?[\d\s-]{10,20}", phone) or len(re.sub(r"\D", "", phone)) < 10:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please add a phone number we can call or WhatsApp (at least 10 digits).")
    items = []
    for i, product in enumerate(profile.products):
        raw = form.get(f"qty_{i}", "0").strip() or "0"
        if not raw.isdigit() or int(raw) > MAX_QTY:
            raise OrderInvalid(f"Please enter a quantity between 0 and {MAX_QTY}.")
        if int(raw) > 0:
            items.append({"name": product.name, "qty": int(raw), "price_inr": product.price_inr,
                          "addon": product.addon})
    if not items and not note:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please choose at least one item, or tell us what you'd like in the note.")
    if items and all(it["addon"] for it in items):
        raise OrderInvalid("Extras go with another item. Please choose an item too.")
    for it in items:
        del it["addon"]
    total = sum(it["qty"] * it["price_inr"] for it in items)
    return {"customer_name": name, "customer_phone": phone, "note": note, "items": items, "total_inr": total}


def order_email(business: Business, profile: Profile, order: Order, items: list[dict],
                confirm_url: str = "", orders_url: str = "") -> tuple[str, str]:
    from app.sites.render import format_inr

    test = "[TEST] " if order.is_test else ""
    code = f" [{order.nonce}]" if order.nonce else ""
    subject = f"{test}New order for {profile.name} from {order.customer_name} ({order.ref}){code}"
    lines = [f"New order {order.ref} for {profile.name}", "", f"Customer: {order.customer_name}",
             f"Phone: {order.customer_phone}"]
    if tel := tel_link(order.customer_phone):
        lines.append(f"Call: {tel}")
    if wa := customer_whatsapp_link(profile.name, order):
        lines.append(f"WhatsApp the customer: {wa}")
    lines.append("")
    if order.nonce:
        lines[1:1] = ["", "This is an automatic test order from LaunchWitness. No customer is waiting.",
                      f"Test code: {order.nonce}"]
    lines += [f"- {it['qty']} x {it['name']} @ {format_inr(it['price_inr'])} = {format_inr(it['qty'] * it['price_inr'])}"
              for it in items] or ["(no items chosen; see note)"]
    lines += ["", f"Estimated total: {format_inr(order.total_inr)}"]
    if order.note:
        lines += ["", "Note from customer:", order.note]
    if confirm_url:
        lines += ["", "Did this email reach you? Tap here to say so (it proves your orders reach you):", confirm_url]
    if orders_url:
        lines += ["", f"See and update all your orders: {orders_url}"]
    lines += ["", f"Placed: {order.created_at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} UTC", "Sent by LaunchWitness"]
    return subject, "\n".join(lines)


def order_recipients(session: Session, settings: Settings, business: Business) -> list[str]:
    """Who gets this shop's order emails. ONE place decides it, for customers' orders and for the
    checker's test order alike: the owner's verified sign-in address. That address was proven at
    sign-in and is proven again by the test order. The app's own mailbox is added only for shops
    we run ourselves, and stands in while a guest practice shop has no owner yet."""
    out = owner_emails(session, business.id)
    if not out or run_by_team(session, business.id):
        if settings.smtp_user.lower() not in {a.lower() for a in out}:
            out.append(settings.smtp_user)
    return out


REF_ALPHABET = "23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ"  # no 0/O/1/I


def new_ref() -> str:
    """Public order reference: random, so it reveals no count and can't be guessed."""
    return "LW-" + "".join(secrets.choice(REF_ALPHABET) for _ in range(8))


TOO_MANY = ("This shop has had a lot of orders from here in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes, "
            "or message the shop directly.")


class TooManyOrders(Exception):
    pass


def check_order_limits(session: Session, settings: Settings, business: Business, visitor: str) -> None:
    """Per visitor (hashed IP) per shop per hour, and per shop per day. Test orders don't count."""
    real = (Order.business_id == business.id, Order.is_test == False)  # noqa: E712
    now = utcnow()
    mine = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
        *real, Order.visitor == visitor, Order.created_at >= now - timedelta(hours=1))).one()
    shop = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
        *real, Order.created_at >= now - timedelta(days=1))).one()
    if mine >= settings.orders_per_visitor_per_hour or shop >= settings.orders_per_shop_per_day:
        audit.record(session, actor="customer", action="order_placed", target=f"business:{business.id}",
                     result="blocked", business_id=business.id,
                     detail="visitor hourly limit" if mine >= settings.orders_per_visitor_per_hour else "shop daily limit")
        raise TooManyOrders


TOKEN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,64}$")


def existing_order(session: Session, business: Business, token: str) -> Order | None:
    """The order already made with this form token (a double tap or a re-sent form), if any."""
    if not TOKEN.match(token):
        return None
    return session.exec(select(Order).where(Order.business_id == business.id, Order.client_token == token)).first()


def order_view(order: Order) -> dict:
    return {"customer_name": order.customer_name, "customer_phone": order.customer_phone, "note": order.note,
            "items": json.loads(order.items_json), "total_inr": order.total_inr, "ref": order.ref}

"""S10.5 go-live checklist: what a real shop needs before "Launch for real".

Drafts and practice launches are never blocked by this. Only a real launch is (routers/launch.py, at plan time and
again at approval). Each item is plain words for the owner. Owner-confirmed steps are stored with the exact value
that was confirmed, so changing the WhatsApp number or the UPI ID / name quietly undoes the confirmation.
"""

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass

from sqlmodel import Session

from app.agents.reader import Profile, indian_mobile
from app.models import Business
from app.safety.access import owner_emails


@dataclass
class Item:
    key: str
    label: str  # what is needed, in plain words
    done: bool
    hint: str = ""  # what to do next when it isn't done


def upi_key(profile: Profile) -> str:
    return f"{profile.upi_id}|{profile.upi_display_name.strip()}"


def whatsapp_confirmed(b: Business, profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.whatsapp) and b.wa_confirmed == profile.whatsapp


def upi_confirmed(b: Business, profile: Profile) -> bool:
    return bool(profile.upi_id and profile.upi_display_name.strip()) and b.upi_confirmed == upi_key(profile)


def checklist(session: Session, b: Business) -> list[Item]:
    p = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json)
    priced = [x for x in p.products if not x.addon and x.price_inr > 0]
    has_way = p.pickup_available or p.delivery_available
    way_ok = has_way and (not p.delivery_available or bool(p.delivery_areas.strip())) \
        and (not p.pickup_available or bool(p.area.strip()))
    return [
        Item("email", "A verified sign-in email for orders and alerts", bool(owner_emails(session, b.id)) and not b.guest_hash,
             "Sign in with your email."),
        Item("shop", "Shop name, shop address and at least one item with a price",
             bool(p.name.strip() and b.subdomain and priced), "Add an item with its price."),
        Item("whatsapp", "Your WhatsApp number, checked by you", whatsapp_confirmed(b, p) and indian_mobile(p.whatsapp) is not None,
             "Add your WhatsApp number, tap “Test this number”, then “Yes, that's me”." if p.whatsapp
             else "Add your WhatsApp number."),
        Item("upi", "Your UPI ID and the name your UPI app shows, checked by you", upi_confirmed(b, p),
             "Do the ₹1 UPI test and confirm the name matches." if p.upi_id and p.upi_display_name.strip()
             else "Add your UPI ID and the name your UPI app shows."),
        Item("fulfilment", "How customers get their order: pickup (your area) and/or delivery (areas and fee)", way_ok,
             "Choose pickup or delivery." if not has_way
             else "Add the areas you deliver to." if p.delivery_available and not p.delivery_areas.strip()
             else "Add your area or locality for pickup."),
        Item("rules", "Your working days and hours (and how many days' notice you need)", bool(p.hours.strip()),
             "Add your working days and hours."),
        Item("agreements", "You confirmed you make or sell these yourself, and accepted the Terms",
             b.own_goods_at is not None and b.terms_at is not None, "Tick both boxes and save."),
        Item("preview", "You looked at your shop's preview at least once", b.previewed_at is not None,
             "Tap “Preview my shop”."),
    ]


def missing(session: Session, b: Business) -> list[Item]:
    return [i for i in checklist(session, b) if not i.done]


def refusal(items: list[Item]) -> str:
    return "Before your shop can go live, please finish: " + "; ".join(i.label.lower() for i in items) + "."


def out(session: Session, b: Business) -> dict:
    items = checklist(session, b)
    return {"ready": all(i.done for i in items), "items": [asdict(i) for i in items]}
"""Orders placed through a seller site's form: validate, store, email."""

import json
import re

from datetime import timedelta

from sqlmodel import Session, func, select

from app import audit
from app.agents.reader import Profile
from app.config import Settings
from app.mail.smtp import Mailer
from app.models import Business, Order, utcnow
from app.safety.access import owner_emails, run_by_team

MAX_QTY = 50

# The owner's order status. New → Confirmed → Paid → Done, or Cancelled before it's done. Paid can be
# skipped (cash on pickup). Nothing goes back, and Done / Cancelled are final.
STATUS_STEPS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "new": ("confirmed", "cancelled"),
    "confirmed": ("paid", "done", "cancelled"),
    "paid": ("done", "cancelled"),
    "done": (),
    "cancelled": (),
}
STATUS_LABELS = {"new": "New", "confirmed": "Confirmed", "paid": "Paid", "done": "Done", "cancelled": "Cancelled"}


def can_move(current: str, to: str) -> bool:
    return to in STATUS_STEPS.get(current, ())


def customer_whatsapp_link(shop_name: str, order: Order) -> str | None:
    """A wa.me link to the CUSTOMER's phone with a ready-typed message from the owner. Nothing is sent by us:
    the owner's own WhatsApp opens with the text, and she presses send."""
    from urllib.parse import quote

    from app.sites.render import format_inr, whatsapp_digits

    number = whatsapp_digits(order.customer_phone)
    if not 11 <= len(number) <= 15:  # 10-digit Indian mobiles were given +91 above
        return None
    first = order.customer_name.split()[0] if order.customer_name.split() else ""
    text = (f"Hi {first}, this is {shop_name}. Got your order {order.ref} for {format_inr(order.total_inr)}. "
            "I'll confirm the details here.")
    return f"https://wa.me/{number}?text={quote(text, safe='')}"


def tel_link(phone: str) -> str:
    from app.sites.render import whatsapp_digits

    digits = whatsapp_digits(phone)
    return f"tel:+{digits}" if digits else ""


class OrderInvalid(ValueError):
    """Message is shown to the customer as-is."""


def parse_order_form(form: dict[str, str], profile: Profile) -> dict:
    if form.get("website"):  # honeypot field, hidden from people
        raise OrderInvalid("Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.")
    name = " ".join(form.get("customer_name", "").split())[:80]
    phone = form.get("customer_phone", "").strip()
    note = form.get("note", "").strip()[:1000]
    if profile.allow_item_message:
        message = " ".join(form.get("item_message", "").split())[:200]
        if message:
            note = f"Message on the item: {message}" + (f"\n{note}" if note else "")
    if not name:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please add your name so we know who the order is for.")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\+?[\d\s-]{10,20}", phone) or len(re.sub(r"\D", "", phone)) < 10:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please add a phone number we can call or WhatsApp (at least 10 digits).")
    items = []
    for i, product in enumerate(profile.products):
        raw = form.get(f"qty_{i}", "0").strip() or "0"
        if not raw.isdigit() or int(raw) > MAX_QTY:
            raise OrderInvalid(f"Please enter a quantity between 0 and {MAX_QTY}.")
        if int(raw) > 0:
            items.append({"name": product.name, "qty": int(raw), "price_inr": product.price_inr,
                          "addon": product.addon})
    if not items and not note:
        raise OrderInvalid("Please choose at least one item, or tell us what you'd like in the note.")
    if items and all(it["addon"] for it in items):
        raise OrderInvalid("Extras go with another item. Please choose an item too.")
    for it in items:
        del it["addon"]
    total = sum(it["qty"] * it["price_inr"] for it in items)
    return {"customer_name": name, "customer_phone": phone, "note": note, "items": items, "total_inr": total}


def order_email(business: Business, profile: Profile, order: Order, items: list[dict],
                confirm_url: str = "", orders_url: str = "") -> tuple[str, str]:
    from app.sites.render import format_inr

    test = "[TEST] " if order.is_test else ""
    code = f" [{order.nonce}]" if order.nonce else ""
    subject = f"{test}New order for {profile.name} from {order.customer_name} ({order.ref}){code}"
    lines = [f"New order {order.ref} for {profile.name}", "", f"Customer: {order.customer_name}",
             f"Phone: {order.customer_phone}"]
    if tel := tel_link(order.customer_phone):
        lines.append(f"Call: {tel}")
    if wa := customer_whatsapp_link(profile.name, order):
        lines.append(f"WhatsApp the customer: {wa}")
    lines.append("")
    if order.nonce:
        lines[1:1] = ["", "This is an automatic test order from LaunchWitness. No customer is waiting.",
                      f"Test code: {order.nonce}"]
    lines += [f"- {it['qty']} x {it['name']} @ {format_inr(it['price_inr'])} = {format_inr(it['qty'] * it['price_inr'])}"
              for it in items] or ["(no items chosen; see note)"]
    lines += ["", f"Estimated total: {format_inr(order.total_inr)}"]
    if order.note:
        lines += ["", "Note from customer:", order.note]
    if confirm_url:
        lines += ["", "Did this email reach you? Tap here to say so (it proves your orders reach you):", confirm_url]
    if orders_url:
        lines += ["", f"See and update all your orders: {orders_url}"]
    lines += ["", f"Placed: {order.created_at:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} UTC", "Sent by LaunchWitness"]
    return subject, "\n".join(lines)


def order_recipients(session: Session, settings: Settings, business: Business) -> list[str]:
    """Who gets this shop's order emails. ONE place decides it, for customers' orders and for the
    checker's test order alike: the owner's verified sign-in address. That address was proven at
    sign-in and is proven again by the test order. The app's own mailbox is added only for shops
    we run ourselves, and stands in while a guest practice shop has no owner yet."""
    out = owner_emails(session, business.id)
    if not out or run_by_team(session, business.id):
        if settings.smtp_user.lower() not in {a.lower() for a in out}:
            out.append(settings.smtp_user)
    return out


REF_ALPHABET = "23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ"  # no 0/O/1/I


def new_ref() -> str:
    """Public order reference: random, so it reveals no count and can't be guessed."""
    return "LW-" + "".join(secrets.choice(REF_ALPHABET) for _ in range(8))


TOO_MANY = ("This shop has had a lot of orders from here in a short time. Please try again in a few minutes, "
            "or message the shop directly.")


class TooManyOrders(Exception):
    pass


def check_order_limits(session: Session, settings: Settings, business: Business, visitor: str) -> None:
    """Per visitor (hashed IP) per shop per hour, and per shop per day. Test orders don't count."""
    real = (Order.business_id == business.id, Order.is_test == False)  # noqa: E712
    now = utcnow()
    mine = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
        *real, Order.visitor == visitor, Order.created_at >= now - timedelta(hours=1))).one()
    shop = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Order).where(
        *real, Order.created_at >= now - timedelta(days=1))).one()
    if mine >= settings.orders_per_visitor_per_hour or shop >= settings.orders_per_shop_per_day:
        audit.record(session, actor="customer", action="order_placed", target=f"business:{business.id}",
                     result="blocked", business_id=business.id,
                     detail="visitor hourly limit" if mine >= settings.orders_per_visitor_per_hour else "shop daily limit")
        raise TooManyOrders

def indian_mobile(value: str) -> str | None:
    """'98765 43210', '+91 98765-43210', '091 9876543210', '919876543210' -> '+919876543210'. None if it isn't an
    Indian mobile (10 digits starting 6-9 after +91 / 91 / 0)."""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\+?[\d\s()-]{10,20}", value.strip()):

    d = re.sub(r"\D", "", value)
    for prefix in ("0091", "091", "91", "0"):

def instagram_handle(value: str) -> str | None:
    """'@meera.bakes', 'instagram.com/meera.bakes/', 'https://www.instagram.com/meera.bakes?igsh=x' -> 'meera.bakes'."""
    v = value.strip()
    v = re.sub(r"^(https?://)?(www\.)?instagram\.com/", "", v, flags=re.I).split("?")[0].strip("/").lstrip("@")

    price_from: bool = False  # the price is a starting price ("from ₹850")

    @field_validator("price_inr", mode="before")
    @classmethod

        if isinstance(v, str):

    @field_validator("category")
    @classmethod
    def _default_category(cls, v: str) -> str:

+"""S15: where a shop sells, when, and how the customer pays. One place for every rule, all pure functions of the
+Profile (plus a date and, for the daily limit, a count). The order form, the server's order check, the shop page, the
+order email, the go-live checklist and the Orders page all ask here, so a rule can't be right in one and wrong in another.
+
+Nothing in here touches the network or the clock by itself: `today` is always passed in (IST by default).
+"""
+
+import math
+import re
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta
+from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
+
+IST = ZoneInfo("Asia/Kolkata")
+
+# ---------- fixed lists (the Reader / the Review form can only pick from these) ----------
+
+SELLING_MODES = ("pickup", "local", "pickup_local", "india", "pickup_india")
+PAYMENT_TERMS = ("upfront", "advance", "on_delivery")
+FOOD_MARKS = ("veg", "egg", "nonveg")
+FOOD_MARK_WORDS = {"veg": "Veg", "egg": "Contains egg", "nonveg": "Non-veg"}
+
+CANCELLATION_PRESETS = {
+    "no_custom": "No cancellations for custom orders.",
+    "full_24h": "Cancel up to 24 hours before for a full refund.",
+    "advance_kept_48h": "Cancel up to 48 hours before. The advance is not refunded.",
+}
+CANCELLATION_CHOICES = (*CANCELLATION_PRESETS, "custom")
+
+MAX_DAYS_AHEAD = 120  # a wanted-by date further out than this is refused
+WEEKDAYS = ("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday")
+
+PIN = re.compile(r"[1-9]\d{5}")
+# a locality: letters (any script), digits, spaces and a few marks; 2-40 characters
+LOCALITY = re.compile(r"[\w][\w .&'’()/-]{1,39}", re.UNICODE)
+
+
+def today_ist() -> date:
+    return datetime.now(UTC).astimezone(IST).date()
+
+
+def parse_date(text: str) -> date | None:
+    try:
+        return date.fromisoformat(text.strip()) if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", text.strip()) else None
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def nice_date(d: date) -> str:
+    return f"{d.day} {d:%b}"
+
+
+# ---------- selling mode ----------
+
+def mode_flags(mode: str) -> tuple[bool, bool]:
+    """(pickup, delivery-of-either-kind) for a selling mode."""
+    return mode.startswith("pickup"), mode.endswith(("local", "india"))
+
+
+def infer_mode(pickup: bool, delivery: bool) -> str:
+    """Older profiles only have the two yes/no boxes: they were local delivery (the only kind there was)."""
+    if pickup and delivery:
+        return "pickup_local"
+    if delivery:
+        return "local"
+    return "pickup" if pickup else ""
+
+
+def offers(profile) -> dict[str, bool]:
+    mode = profile.selling_mode
+    return {"pickup": mode.startswith("pickup"), "local": mode.endswith("local"), "india": mode.endswith("india")}
+
+
+def mode_words(profile) -> str:
+    o = offers(profile)
+    parts = ["pickup"] if o["pickup"] else []
+    if o["local"]:
+        parts.append("local delivery")
+    if o["india"]:
+        parts.append("shipping across India")
+    return " and ".join(parts)
+
+
+# ---------- delivery areas ----------
+
+@dataclass
+class Areas:
+    localities: list[str]
+    pins: list[str]
+    bad: list[str]
+
+
+def parse_areas(text: str) -> Areas:
+    """'Baner, Aundh, 411045' -> localities ['Baner','Aundh'], pins ['411045']. Anything that is neither a 6-digit PIN code
+    nor a plain place name (for example a 5-digit number) is returned in `bad`. Lenient: never raises."""
+    loc: list[str] = []
+    pins: list[str] = []
+    bad: list[str] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for tok in re.split(r"[,;\n]+", text or ""):
+        tok = " ".join(tok.split())
+        if not tok or tok.lower() in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add(tok.lower())
+        if re.fullmatch(r"\d+", tok):
+            (pins if PIN.fullmatch(tok) else bad).append(tok)
+        elif LOCALITY.fullmatch(tok) and not re.fullmatch(r"[\d ]+", tok):
+            loc.append(tok)
+        else:
+            bad.append(tok)
+    return Areas(loc, pins, bad)
+
+
+def areas_error(text: str) -> str | None:
+    """A plain-English problem with the list she typed, or None. Used when she saves (not when an old profile loads)."""
+    a = parse_areas(text)
+    if a.bad:
+        shown = ", ".join(f"“{b[:20]}”" for b in a.bad[:3])
+        return (f"These don't look like a locality or a 6-digit PIN code: {shown}. "
+                "Separate places with commas, for example: Baner, Aundh, 411045.")
+    if len(a.localities) + len(a.pins) > 40:
+        return "Please keep the list to 40 places or fewer."
+    return None
+
+
+def area_phrase(profile) -> str:
+    a = parse_areas(profile.delivery_areas)
+    items = [*a.localities, *a.pins]
+    if not items:
+        return ""
+    return items[0] if len(items) == 1 else ", ".join(items[:-1]) + " and " + items[-1]
+
+
+def serves(profile, address: str, pin: str) -> bool:
+    """Local delivery: is this PIN, or this address, somewhere she delivers? A listed PIN matches the PIN. A listed
+    locality matches when the address names it (whole word, any case). With nothing listed nobody is served."""
+    a = parse_areas(profile.delivery_areas)
+    if pin in a.pins:
+        return True
+    low = address.lower()
+    return any(re.search(rf"(?<!\w){re.escape(loc.lower())}(?!\w)", low) for loc in a.localities)
+
+
+# ---------- money ----------
+
+def items_total(items: list[dict]) -> int:
+    return sum(int(it["qty"]) * int(it["price_inr"]) for it in items)
+
+
+def fee_for(profile, fulfilment: str, items_sum: int) -> int:
+    """The delivery or shipping charge, from the profile only (never from anything the browser sent)."""
+    if fulfilment != "delivery" or items_sum <= 0:
+        return 0
+    o = offers(profile)
+    if o["india"]:
+        return profile.shipping_fee_inr
+    if o["local"]:
+        if profile.free_delivery_above_inr and items_sum >= profile.free_delivery_above_inr:
+            return 0
+        return profile.delivery_fee_inr
+    return 0
+
+
+def fee_words(profile) -> str:
+    """The charge as the customer reads it on the shop."""
+    o = offers(profile)
+    if o["india"]:
+        return f"Shipping {_inr(profile.shipping_fee_inr)}" if profile.shipping_fee_inr else "Free shipping"
+    base = f"Delivery {_inr(profile.delivery_fee_inr)}" if profile.delivery_fee_inr else "Free delivery"
+    if profile.free_delivery_above_inr and profile.delivery_fee_inr:
+        base += f", free above {_inr(profile.free_delivery_above_inr)}"
+    return base
+
+
+def _inr(n: int) -> str:
+    from app.sites.render import format_inr
+
+    return format_inr(n)
+
+
+def pay_split(profile, total: int) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """(pay now, pay later) in whole rupees, from the SERVER's total. Upfront: all now. Advance: N% rounded UP to a
+    whole rupee (never 0 for a real total, never more than the total). On delivery / pickup: nothing now."""
+    if total <= 0:
+        return 0, 0
+    if profile.payment_terms == "upfront":
+        return total, 0
+    if profile.payment_terms == "advance":
+        now = min(total, max(1, math.ceil(total * profile.advance_percent / 100)))
+        return now, total - now
+    return 0, total
+
+
+def terms_words(profile) -> str:
+    """One plain line saying how she is paid, for the shop and the email."""
+    cash = " Cash is welcome." if profile.accepts_cash else ""
+    t = profile.payment_terms
+    if t == "upfront":
+        return "Please pay the full amount by UPI after you order." + cash
+    if t == "advance":
+        return f"Please pay {profile.advance_percent}% now by UPI to confirm your order. You pay the rest when you collect or receive it." + cash
+    how = "cash or UPI" if profile.accepts_cash and profile.upi_id else "cash" if profile.accepts_cash else "UPI"
+    return f"Nothing to pay now. You pay when you collect or receive your order, by {how}."
+
+
+def payment_label(profile_terms: str, status: str, pay_now: int, pay_later: int, total: int) -> str:
+    """What the owner reads next to an order: where the money stands. Derived from the saved terms and her status."""
+    if status == "cancelled":
+        return "Cancelled"
+    if total <= 0:
+        return ""
+    if profile_terms == "upfront":
+        return "Fully paid" if status in ("paid", "done") else f"Waiting for full payment ({_inr(total)})"
+    if profile_terms == "advance":
+        if status == "done":
+            return "Fully paid"
+        if status == "paid":
+            return f"Advance paid · {_inr(pay_later)} due on delivery"
+        return f"Waiting for the advance ({_inr(pay_now)})"
+    return "Paid" if status in ("paid", "done") else f"Due on delivery ({_inr(total)})"
+
+
+def paid_action_label(profile_terms: str) -> str:
+    return {"advance": "Advance received", "upfront": "Payment received"}.get(profile_terms, "Mark paid")
+
+
+# ---------- UPI link and QR with the right amount ----------
+
+def upi_order_uri(profile, amount: int, ref: str) -> str | None:
+    """upi://pay link for an order: the exact whole-rupee amount, and the order ref as the note. None when she has no UPI ID
+    or there is nothing to pay now."""
+    from urllib.parse import quote, urlencode
+
+    if not profile.upi_id or amount <= 0:
+        return None
+    q = {"pa": profile.upi_id, "pn": profile.name, "am": f"{int(amount)}.00", "cu": "INR", "tn": f"Order {ref}"}
+    return "upi://pay?" + urlencode(q, quote_via=quote, safe="@")
+
+
+# ---------- taking a break ----------
+
+def on_break(profile, today: date | None = None) -> bool:
+    """On a break while the switch is on, unless she gave a return date that is today or already past."""
+    if not profile.on_break:
+        return False
+    back = parse_date(profile.back_on)
+    return not (back and back <= (today or today_ist()))
+
+
+def break_line(profile) -> str:
+    back = parse_date(profile.back_on)
+    return f"Taking a break, back on {nice_date(back)}" if back else "Taking a break"
+
+
+def break_refusal(profile) -> str:
+    back = parse_date(profile.back_on)
+    when = f" We're back on {nice_date(back)}." if back else " Please check back later."
+    return f"{profile.name} is taking a break and isn't taking orders right now.{when}"
+
+
+# ---------- the date rules ----------
+
+def earliest(profile, today: date) -> date:
+    return today + timedelta(days=profile.min_notice_days)
+
+
+def latest(today: date) -> date:
+    return today + timedelta(days=MAX_DAYS_AHEAD)
+
+
+def days_off_words(profile) -> str:
+    return ", ".join(WEEKDAYS[d] for d in profile.days_off)
+
+
+def date_required(profile) -> bool:
+    return bool(profile.min_notice_days or profile.days_off or profile.max_orders_per_day)
+
+
+def date_problem(profile, wanted: date, today: date, taken: int) -> str | None:
+    """Why this wanted-by date can't be used, in plain words, or None. `taken` = her orders already on that date."""
+    first = earliest(profile, today)
+    if wanted < first:
+        if profile.min_notice_days:
+            n = profile.min_notice_days
+            return (f"{profile.name} needs at least {n} day{'s' if n != 1 else ''} to prepare an order. "
+                    f"The earliest date you can pick is {nice_date(first)}.")
+        return "Please pick today or a later date."
+    if wanted > latest(today):
+        return f"Please pick a date within the next {MAX_DAYS_AHEAD // 30} months."
+    if wanted.weekday() in profile.days_off:
+        return f"{profile.name} doesn't deliver or hand over orders on {WEEKDAYS[wanted.weekday()]}s. Please pick another day."
+    if profile.max_orders_per_day and taken >= profile.max_orders_per_day:
+        return f"{profile.name} is fully booked on {nice_date(wanted)}. Please pick another date."
+    return None
+
+
+def full_dates(counts: dict[str, int], profile) -> list[str]:
+    """Dates (ISO) already at her daily limit, for the date picker. No names, no numbers: just which days are full."""
+    if not profile.max_orders_per_day:
+        return []
+    return sorted(d for d, n in counts.items() if n >= profile.max_orders_per_day)
+
+
+# ---------- cancellation ----------
+
+def cancellation_line(profile) -> str:
+    if profile.cancellation_preset == "custom":
+        return profile.cancellation_text.strip()
+    return CANCELLATION_PRESETS.get(profile.cancellation_preset, "")
+
+
+# ---------- go-live ----------
+
+def selling_problem(profile) -> str:
+    """'' when the selling mode and everything it needs are filled in; else the next thing to do, in plain words."""
+    if profile.selling_mode not in SELLING_MODES:
+        return "Choose how customers get their order: pickup, local delivery or shipping across India."
+    if not profile.city.strip():
+        return "Add your city."
+    if not profile.area.strip():
+        return "Add your area or locality (not your full address)."
+    o = offers(profile)
+    if o["local"]:
+        a = parse_areas(profile.delivery_areas)
+        if not (a.localities or a.pins):
+            return "Add the localities or PIN codes you deliver to."
+        if areas_error(profile.delivery_areas):
+            return areas_error(profile.delivery_areas) or ""
+    if o["india"] and profile.dispatch_days < 1:
+        return "Add how many days you take to dispatch an order."
+    return ""

def load(name: str, live_only: bool = False) -> dict:
    path = CLAUDE / f"{name}.json"
    if not path.is_file():
        if STRICT:
            pytest.fail(f"{name}.json missing: run scripts/capture_live_fixtures.py")
        pytest.skip(f"{name}.json not captured yet (live call on the owner's laptop)")
    data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    theme_only = bool(data.get("_theme_placeholder"))  # S14: only the theme fields are hand-written; the rest is live
    if STRICT and "_note" in data:
        pytest.fail(f"{name}.json is still a hand-written placeholder" + (" (S14 theme fields: capture them live, "
                                                                          "see the S14 PR)" if theme_only else ""))
    if "_note" in data and live_only and not theme_only:
        pytest.skip(f"{name}.json is still a placeholder; this quality gate is for the live reply")
    return data


# ---------- Reader ----------

@pytest.mark.parametrize("seller", SAMPLES + HARD_CASES)
def test_reader_fixture_validates(seller):
    p = Profile.model_validate(load(f"reader_{seller}"))
    assert 2 <= len({x.category for x in p.products}) <= 5 or len(p.products) < 4


def hard(case: str) -> dict:
    return json.loads((HARD / f"{case}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
"""Make ONE live Claude call per target and save the reply as a fixture.

Targets:
  reader:<seller_id>   sample sellers (tests/fixtures/sellers) and hard cases (tests/fixtures/sellers_hard)
  namer:<seller_id>    uses that seller's saved reader fixture as the profile
  doctor:<check>       a realistic failure of that launch check (doctor:all = every check)

Money rules (session 6): one call per target, never a retry; the run STOPS at
the first failed target so a broken prompt can't burn credit. Every reply is
also written to replay/raw/claude/<fixture>.json (git-ignored) so a bad reply
can be debugged offline instead of paying for another call. All calls go
through LiveClaudeClient (max_tokens, daily cap, ClaudeUsage rows).

Usage (CLAUDE_MODE=live and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment):
    cd backend && ../.venv/bin/python ../scripts/capture_live_fixtures.py reader:meera_cakes namer:meera_cakes
    (Windows venv: use ../.venv/Scripts/python.exe instead of ../.venv/bin/python)
    ... --dry-run <targets>   worst-case cost per target, no key needed, no call made
    ... --report              today's live spend from the ClaudeUsage table, per fixture

S14 (shop themes): the Reader now also picks a theme, an accent and three short lines of page copy. The saved Reader
replies carry hand-written values for these (marked `_note` + `_theme_placeholder`). To replace them with live ones
WITHOUT touching the rest of the saved replies (prices, categories and everything the other tests pin):

    cd backend && CLAUDE_MODE=live ../.venv/bin/python ../scripts/capture_live_fixtures.py --theme-only reader:themes
    (reader:themes = six sellers, reader:themes-all = all 12; or name some: --theme-only reader:meera_cakes reader:tailor)
    ... --theme-only --dry-run reader:themes     worst-case cost first, no key needed

One live Reader call per seller (strong model), stops at the first failure, daily cap applies (set it to <= $0.10).
Only `theme`, `accent` and `section_copy` are copied into the saved file; `_note` / `_theme_placeholder` are removed.

# e2e: browser flows (Playwright)

```bash
cd e2e && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
npx playwright test                                   # against the Docker stack: https://launchwitness.localhost
LW_BASE=http://localhost:8000 LW_MAIL= npx playwright test   # against the dev server (DEV_MODE=true shows links)
```

- **Docker stack** (default): start it first (`deploy/README.md`). Sign-in links are read from Mailpit
  (http://localhost:8025). The browser accepts Caddy's local CA **only for `.localhost`**.
- **Dev server**: the settings also read the repo's `.env`, so pin everything that could reach the real world
  (fixture Claude, fakes, a scratch database, SMTP to a closed port so no email can leave):

  ```bash
  cd backend && DEV_MODE=true APP_DOMAIN=localhost APP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000 USE_FAKES=true CLAUDE_MODE=fixture     GODADDY_ENV=ote ALLOW_PURCHASE=false ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= GODADDY_API_KEY= GODADDY_API_SECRET= MONITOR_ENABLED=false     ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@launchwitness.localhost ADMIN_TOKEN=dev-server-only-admin-token     SMTP_HOST=127.0.0.1 SMTP_PORT=9 SMTP_SECURITY=starttls SMTP_PASSWORD= [REDACTED]     DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./data/e2e-dev.db SIGNIN_LINKS_PER_EMAIL_PER_DAY=100 SIGNIN_LINKS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR=200     VISITOR_DESCRIBES_PER_DAY=50 VISITOR_LAUNCHES_PER_DAY=50 USER_DESCRIBES_PER_DAY=50     ../.venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000
  ```
- Flows: (a) sign-up → pending → team approves → describe → practice launch → real launch (pretend GoDaddy) → a
  customer order on the shop's own host → report → share link opened logged out; (b) two sellers can't reach each
  other's shop, preview, orders, export, names, plans, report or share by URL; (c) guest practice is kept after signing
  in; (d) Privacy and Terms are one click from sign-in; (e) "Start" asks to sign in first and returns to Describe, routing
  (refresh, Back/Forward, step header, Page not found) and the demo shop; (f) every link and button in the owner's preview
  stays inside the shop. Flow (a) also checks the go-live gate and the Orders page (status + WhatsApp link).
  (g) landing menu; (h) S12: staged fault + Doctor trace, symptom box, hop track, "Something breaks", photos;
  (i) S13: an order placed while the team's practice "mail down" switch is on shows "Email to you: retrying" and becomes
  "sent" after it's off; sign-in while the mail server is unreachable says "We're having trouble sending email" and the
  link still arrives. The sign-in flow runs `docker stop/start launchwitness-local-mailpit-1` (`LW_MAILPIT_CONTAINER`
  to rename), so it only runs on the local Docker stack and is skipped elsewhere.
- Screenshots (not a test): `npx playwright test -c screens.config.ts` → `docs/screenshots/s10-5/` (`LW_SHOTS=<dir>`).
- Not covered here: the owner tapping "Yes, I got it". On a practice server the test-order email goes to the
  pretend inbox (in server memory), so there's no link to tap; pytest covers that path
  (`test_s9_phase3_proof.py::test_accepted_is_not_delivered_until_the_owner_taps`), and on the VPS it's a manual step.
- API calls are made by the page itself (`fetch` with the browser's cookies and CSRF token), like the real frontend;
  Node can't resolve `*.localhost` on Windows.

"""S15: render three themed shops with every new field filled in, for the order-form and info-section screenshots.

    .venv/bin/python scripts/render_s15_shots.py <html_dir>
    node scripts/shoot_s15.js <html_dir> docs/screenshots/s15
"""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "backend"))
from app.agents.reader import Profile  # noqa: E402
from app.sites.render import render_site  # noqa: E402

GALLERY = ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "fixtures" / "site_gallery"
SHOPS = {"bakery": "cake_studio", "handmade": "candle_maker", "tailor": "tailor_studio"}

NEW = {
    "bakery": {"selling_mode": "pickup_local", "city": "Pune", "area": "Baner", "delivery_areas": "Baner, Aundh, 411045",
               "delivery_fee_inr": 80, "free_delivery_above_inr": 1500, "payment_terms": "advance", "advance_percent": 30,
               "accepts_cash": True, "cancellation_preset": "advance_kept_48h", "allergens": "Contains nuts, gluten and dairy",
               "days_off": [0], "time_slots": ["10am-1pm", "4pm-7pm"], "max_orders_per_day": 4, "min_notice_days": 2},
    "handmade": {"selling_mode": "pickup_india", "city": "Jaipur", "area": "Malviya Nagar", "shipping_fee_inr": 70,
                 "dispatch_days": 3, "shipping_note": "Ships via courier, tracking on WhatsApp", "payment_terms": "upfront",
                 "cancellation_preset": "no_custom", "min_notice_days": 1, "days_off": [5, 6]},
    "tailor": {"selling_mode": "local", "city": "Indore", "area": "Vijay Nagar", "delivery_areas": "Vijay Nagar, 452010",
               "delivery_fee_inr": 0, "payment_terms": "on_delivery", "accepts_cash": True, "cancellation_preset": "custom",
               "cancellation_text": "Alterations can be cancelled before cutting starts.", "on_break": True, "back_on": "2099-12-05",
               "min_notice_days": 5},
}


def main(out: Path) -> None:
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for theme, seller in SHOPS.items():
        raw = json.loads((GALLERY / f"{seller}.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        raw.update({"theme": theme, "accent": "", "upi_id": "shop.demo@okaxis", "upi_display_name": "Demo Shop", **NEW[theme]})
        if theme == "bakery":
            for i, item in enumerate(raw["products"][:4]):
                item["food_mark"] = ["veg", "veg", "egg", "veg"][i]
        p = Profile.model_validate(raw)
        (out / f"{theme}.html").write_text(render_site(p, shop="x", full_dates=["2099-12-01"]), encoding="utf-8")
        print(theme, "<-", seller)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(Path(sys.argv[1]))

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Save THIS session's Claude Code transcript into the repo, redacted and scanned.
#
# Usage:  bash scripts/save-transcript.sh <session-number> <milestone> [transcript.jsonl]
#   e.g.  bash scripts/save-transcript.sh 2 m2
#   -> replay/sessions/<YYYY-MM-DD>-s2-m2.jsonl
#
# - Without a path, takes the most recently modified transcript for this repo
#   under ~/.claude/projects (subagent files are skipped).
# - Replaces with [redacted-email]: every address in REDACT_EMAILS (comma-separated;
#   defaults to the repo's git user.email) AND any personal webmail address.
# - Replaces each secret-looking VALUE with [REDACTED] (strict patterns: Anthropic,
#   GitHub, AWS keys, private keys, api_secret=…, password=…) and keeps the rest.
#   Code like `password: SecretStr` and base64 screenshot data are not flagged.
# - Re-scans; if anything real-looking remains, nothing is saved and it exits 1:
#   never commit a transcript the scan refused.

set -euo pipefail

N="${1:?session number, e.g. 2}"
